title: Amazing Tour, Amazing Host
text: As first time visitors to Barcelona, this was by far our favorite tour. While the tour itself was truly amazing with stunning views and delicious wine, our guide is what made it exceptional. Kyra is extremely knowledgeable about the history of the region, but she is also enthusiastically invested in sharing this information with others. We enjoyed her passion for her culture and her relatable humor.

title: Majestic Monseratt
text: We visited Montserrat Basilica and Monastery yesterday. It was a fantastic trip. Our tour guide, Thais, did a fantastic job! She was so knowledgeable and shared so much history of the area. We loved every minute. We saw the Black Madonna and enjoyed a wine tasting while we were there. If you are considering going, please go! You won't regret it!
